report.explanation: Current evidence shows a healthy checkout: order span OK at 68ms, payment p95 78ms with 0.001 error rate and zero dependency timeouts or pool waiters. The order deployment (3.0.6, 27h old, valid config) cannot by itself establish latency. No observation supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate is substantiated; hand off for downstream and error telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces for order's downstream calls (inventory, payment, postgresql) to locate any failing or slow span
Error-rate and latency metrics for order and inventory services, not only payment
Logs or span statuses showing errors/timeouts during the alert window
Baseline comparison of payment p95/error rate to confirm whether 78ms/0.001 is anomalous
